newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares ease back on meagre volume.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares ease back on meagre volume.

text.p: Slovenian shares eased 0.29 percent on Wednesday.
"Turnover will remain low and prices are most likely to continue falling, but it is hard to say when this trend will end," Toni Apollonio, an analyst at A banka said.
* The SBI index fell 3.9 points to 1,334.36.
* Overall six shares fell, five rose and two were unchanged, while 13 were untraded.
* Construction company GPG was the biggest gainer, jumping 10 percent to 6,600 tolars on volume of 10 shares. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
